title: When the Pandemic Came to Rural Wisconsin

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责为《纽约时报》的每日简报栏目 DealBook 报道商业与政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 现场直播部分精选访谈，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily, today.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《今日简报》。

sentences.en: From the earliest days of the pandemic, my colleague, Julie Bosman, began talking to an official in rural Wisconsin who was preparing for the worSt.
sentences.zh: 从疫情爆发的初期开始，我的同事朱莉·博斯曼就开始与威斯康星州农村地区的一名官员进行交谈，当时她正在为最坏的情况做准备。

sentences.en: The worst has now arrived.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的情况现在已经降临。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月20日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hello, Patty.
sentences.zh: 你好，帕蒂。

sentences.en: Thanks for calling back.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你回电。

sentences.en: I was working with some new technology and needed a little assist to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 我当时在用一些新技术，需要一点帮助来弄清楚它。

sentences.en: Julie, tell me about Patty.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，跟我讲讲帕蒂吧。

sentences.en: I first got to know Patty Schockner in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我最早认识帕蒂·肖克纳是在2018年。

sentences.en: She was a Democrat who had just won a seat in the Wisconsin State Senate, and she won in a pretty conservative area.
sentences.zh: 她是一位民主党人，刚刚赢得威斯康星州参议院的一个席位，而且她是在一个相当保守的地区胜出的。

sentences.en: St. Crick County is 94,000 people, very rural.
sentences.zh: 圣克鲁斯县有9.4万人口，非常乡村化。

sentences.en: Where I live, we're right next to the Snowmobile Trail.
sentences.zh: 我住的地方紧挨着雪地摩托车道。

sentences.en: So, you know, I just love that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我非常喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Every winter, that's the best part, is really hopping on our snowmobiles and going.
sentences.zh: 每年冬天，最棒的部分就是骑上我们的雪地摩托出发。

sentences.en: And it seemed to me that one of the reasons that she had won that seat was because she was such a known person in the community.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，她能赢得那个席位的原因之一，是因为她在当地是个家喻户晓的人物。

sentences.en: Well, my dad's family's been here forever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我父亲的家族在这里生活了很久。

sentences.en: And, you know, my parents graduated from high school in Somerset.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我父母是在萨默塞特读的高中毕业。

sentences.en: Me and my husband graduated from high school in Somerset.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫也是在萨默塞特读的高中毕业。

sentences.en: Our kids all graduated from high school in Somerset.
sentences.zh: 我们的孩子也都在萨默塞特读的高中毕业。

sentences.en: And now we have grandkids in Somerset.
sentences.zh: 现在我们在萨默塞特还有了孙辈。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we've got some pretty deep roots here.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们的根基在这里相当深厚。

sentences.en: So Patty served in the state legislature in Wisconsin, but that is really only a part-time job.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂曾在威斯康星州立法机构任职，但这其实只是一份兼职工作。

sentences.en: Her day job, one that she had held for several years, was the chief medical examiner in St. Croix County.
sentences.zh: 她的正职——她已经做了好几年的工作——是圣克鲁斯县的首席法医。

sentences.en: And what does it mean to be a medical examiner in a county like that?
sentences.zh: 在这样一个县当法医意味着什么？

sentences.en: In Patty's case, she directed a team of four other investigators, and these were the people who showed up when there was a car accident, when there was a suicide,
sentences.zh: 对帕蒂来说，她领导着一个由其他四名调查员组成的团队，这些人会在发生车祸、自杀时出现，

sentences.en: when there was a gun death, when there was any kind of death that happened under suspicious circumstances, or when no one else was there, when the death occurred.
sentences.zh: 当发生枪击致死、任何在可疑情况下发生的死亡，或者当死亡发生时没有其他人在场时，他们都会出现。

sentences.en: So it was Patty's job to go there, gather the evidence, work with other agencies, and figure out what had happened.
sentences.zh: 所以帕蒂的工作就是去现场，收集证据，与其他机构合作，弄清楚究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: And this job requires Patty to work with families during what is probably the worst moment of their lives.
sentences.zh: 这项工作要求帕蒂在人们可能经历人生中最糟糕时刻的时候与家属打交道。

sentences.en: It's our job to be able to, you know, connect with them and be able to help them really adjust to this new life without that person that they love.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作是能够，你知道的，与他们建立联系，并真正帮助他们适应没有了他们所爱之人的新生活。

sentences.en: And if we do it wrong, we can cause negative impacts onto the family and cause more trauma.
sentences.zh: 如果我们做错了，就会对家庭造成负面影响，并引发更多的心理创伤。

sentences.en: They're dealing with trauma.
sentences.zh: 他们正在应对创伤。

sentences.en: And as a death investigator, you acknowledge that you will be a trigger to people forever.
sentences.zh: 作为一名死亡调查员，你必须承认，你将永远成为人们的心理触发点。

sentences.en: Because if they call 911 and ask for, you know, ask for an ambulance to help save their loved one, when they see you as a first responder,
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们拨打911求助，你知道的，要求救护车来帮助拯救他们所爱的人，当他们看到你作为急救人员出现时，

sentences.en: you're always that person that did everything you could to help.
sentences.zh: 你总是那个尽了一切努力去帮忙的人。

sentences.en: But as a last responder, you're the person that took all that hope away.
sentences.zh: 但作为最后到达现场的人，你却是那个带走所有希望的人。

sentences.en: And you confirmed that my loved one was deceased.
sentences.zh: 并且你确认了我所爱的人已经离世。

sentences.en: We are continuing to follow new developments of the spread of the mysterious coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 我们正在持续关注神秘冠状病毒传播的新进展。

sentences.en: World Health Organization officials hold an emergency meeting today.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织官员今天举行紧急会议。

sentences.en: So as the pandemic begins, Patty was in a really unique position.
sentences.zh: 因此，在疫情开始时，帕蒂处于一个非常独特的立场。

sentences.en: As a lawmaker, she was thinking about how to protect her constituents.
sentences.zh: 作为一名立法者，她一直在思考如何保护她的选民。

sentences.en: And as the chief medical examiner, it's her job to plan for a worst-case scenario.
sentences.zh: 而作为首席法医，她的工作是为最坏的情况做计划。

sentences.en: Back in China, the death toll from the coronavirus outbreak is rising over the weekend to 361 cases in China.
sentences.zh: 远在中国的冠状病毒疫情死亡人数在周末上升到中国境内361例。

sentences.en: So she was glued to the news from China.
sentences.zh: 因此，她密切关注着来自中国的消息。

sentences.en: Our top story, Italy is closing all schools, universities, and cinemas.
sentences.zh: 我们的头条新闻，意大利正在关闭所有学校、大学和电影院。

sentences.en: She was watching very closely what was happening in Italy.
sentences.zh: 她一直在密切关注意大利发生的事情。

sentences.en: The death toll there has jumped to 107 now.
sentences.zh: 那里的死亡人数现在已飙升至107人。

sentences.en: And she was thinking, what do I do if this virus comes to my rural county in western Wisconsin?
sentences.zh: 她在想，如果这种病毒来到我位于威斯康星州西部的乡村县，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: You know, when you work in emergency services, you plan all the time for events, whether it's a plane crash or a bus crash or a tornado.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你在应急服务部门工作时，你一直在为各种事件做计划，不管是飞机失事、公共汽车相撞还是龙卷风。

sentences.en: But you plan and you plan and you plan.
sentences.zh: 但你计划、计划、不断地计划。

sentences.en: So Patty is counting hospitals.
sentences.zh: 所以帕蒂在清点医院。

sentences.en: She's counting ventilators.
sentences.zh: 她在清点呼吸机。

sentences.en: She's thinking about what is going to happen if this actually comes here.
sentences.zh: 她在思考，如果这真的来到这里，会发生什么。

sentences.en: There are certain things that I wanted to make sure that we have because as a medical examiner, I knew what we had for resources on crematoriums, funeral homes, who had coolers,
sentences.zh: 有些事情我想要确保我们拥有，因为作为一名法医，我知道我们在火葬场、殡仪馆、谁有冷藏设备、

sentences.en: who didn't have coolers, where would these bodies go?
sentences.zh: 谁没有冷藏设备方面拥有什么资源，这些遗体将运往何处？

sentences.en: What would happen if you had multiple people at one time, a guy, and you didn't have the resources to pick them up?
sentences.zh: 如果你同时有很多人死亡，一个人，而你却没有资源去运送他们，会发生什么？

sentences.en: And every horror story we heard of, it made me think of, okay, what would we do when and if this happened here?
sentences.zh: 我们听到的每一个恐怖故事，都让我想到，好吧，当这种事情在这里发生时，我们会怎么做？

sentences.en: So that's why we made the decisions that we did to get a refrigerator truck ahead of time and secure it so that we would have it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们做出那样的决定，提前采购一辆冷藏卡车并将其固定好，以便我们能拥有它。

sentences.en: And I think nothing better encapsulates how much planning Patty was doing than her decision in March to rent a refrigerated truck in case there were so many deaths that the funeral homes couldn't handle the capacity.
sentences.zh: 我想没有什么比她在三月份决定租一辆冷藏卡车以防殡仪馆无法处理过多遗体更契合帕蒂做了多少规划了。

sentences.en: And this was before there was a single confirmed coronavirus case in her county.
sentences.zh: 而这发生在她的县里出现哪怕一例确诊冠状病毒病例之前。

sentences.en: So well before the rest of us, she is planning for the worSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，远在我们其他人之前，她就在为最坏的情况做准备了。

sentences.en: Patty just seemed to be one step ahead or sometimes several steps ahead in the planning.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂似乎总能领先一步，有时甚至在规划中领先好几步。

sentences.en: And I realized at this point that this was going to be a really interesting person to keep in touch with as the pandemic went on.
sentences.zh: 我当时意识到，随着疫情的发展，这将是一个非常有趣且值得保持联系的人。

sentences.en: Did you get any reaction from people you knew, from people in the community about the preparations that you were making?
sentences.zh: 你从认识的人、社区居民那里，对你正在做的准备工作有什么反应吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, this was all happening in New York.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这一切都发生在纽约。

sentences.en: It's not going to happen here.
sentences.zh: 这不会在这里发生。

sentences.en: I mean, you're talking spring break.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你当时说的是春假。

sentences.en: You're talking the end of the winter in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 你说的正是威斯康星州的冬末。

sentences.en: People want to do stuff.
sentences.zh: 人们想要做点事情。

sentences.en: They want to be engaged with people.
sentences.zh: 他们想要与人交往。

sentences.en: You have to remember at this point, the virus really did feel like it was something that was happening in cities, in New York, in Los Angeles, Chicago, Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，在那个时候，病毒确实感觉像是发生在城市里的事情，在纽约、洛杉矶、芝加哥、密尔沃基。

sentences.en: But it didn't feel like it was happening in places like St. Croix County, which are very rural.
sentences.zh: 但它感觉不像是会发生在像圣克鲁斯县这样非常乡村的地方。

sentences.en: But despite that, Tony Evers, the Democratic governor, issued a pretty sweeping stay-at-home order.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，民主党州长托尼·埃弗斯还是发布了一项相当广泛的居家令。

sentences.en: And that really upset a lot of people in Paddy's County who chafed at these restrictions and felt that they were really unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 这确实惹恼了帕蒂所在县的许多人，他们对这些限制感到恼火，并认为这些限制完全没有必要。

sentences.en: Around here, because, you know, being a Democratic senator in a Republican area, there were people that just, you know, I was fear-mongering, that it wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 在我们这里，你知道的，因为作为一个在共和党地区的民主党参议员，有些人就是觉得，你知道的，我在散布恐惧，这并不是真的。

sentences.en: It's just a hoax.
sentences.zh: 这只是个骗局。

sentences.en: And when you look at a population of 94,000 and they say there's 23 people with COVID, you're like, well, what's the big deal?
sentences.zh: 当你看到一个9.4万人口的群体，而他们说有23个人感染了新冠，你就会想，这有什么大不了的？

sentences.en: What does it matter?
sentences.zh: 这有什么关系？

sentences.en: It's not going to impact me.
sentences.zh: 它不会影响到我。

sentences.en: I don't know them.
sentences.zh: 我不认识他们。

sentences.en: I don't know anybody who has COVID.
sentences.zh: 我不认识任何感染了新冠的人。

sentences.en: But Paddy was adamant.
sentences.zh: 但帕蒂态度坚决。

sentences.en: She was looking at the science.
sentences.zh: 她在研究科学数据。

sentences.en: She felt that it was better to be prepared for a situation that might happen than to not be prepared.
sentences.zh: 她认为，为可能发生的情况做好准备，总比毫无准备要好。

sentences.en: So at the time, she was really advocating for people to stay home.
sentences.zh: 所以在当时，她确实在倡导人们呆在家中。

sentences.en: She was advocating for people to social distance.
sentences.zh: 她一直在倡导人们保持社交距离。

sentences.en: She was trying to do everything that she could to prevent the virus from coming to her county.
sentences.zh: 她试图尽一切努力阻止病毒进入她的县。

sentences.en: And as the summer kind of began, just thinking about that time, it seems like it was just kind of a steady little trickle of cases, like throughout, you know, June, July.
sentences.zh: 当夏天开始的时候，回想那个时期，感觉病例似乎只是一股稳定的细流，比如贯穿整个，你知道的，六月、七月。

sentences.en: What was happening with the refrigerated truck and everything that you had done to prepare?
sentences.zh: 冷藏卡车以及你为做准备所做的一切现在怎么样了？

sentences.en: Was that just kind of sitting there waiting or what was happening?
sentences.zh: 那是就那样放在那里等待着，还是发生了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it wasn't plugged in.
sentences.zh: 所以它没有插电。

sentences.en: It was there.
sentences.zh: 它就在那里。

sentences.en: And we just had it on standby.
sentences.zh: 我们只是让它处于待命状态。

sentences.en: There was one time when we did use it during the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天确实有一次我们用过它。

sentences.en: We had to turn it on and use it.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不把它打开并使用它。

sentences.en: But yeah, it was just there.
sentences.zh: 但是的，它就放在那里。

sentences.en: But I just was not prepared to send it back because I was afraid that if I sent it back, I wouldn't get another one if I needed it.
sentences.zh: 但我根本不准备把它退回去，因为我担心如果我把它退回去，当我需要的时候我就租不到另一辆了。

sentences.en: Did it bring you a kind of comfort just knowing that it was there in case you needed it?
sentences.zh: 知道它就在那里以防万一，这会给你带来一种安慰吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, it did.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Truly, it did.
sentences.zh: 真的，确实如此。

sentences.en: So she is not starting to second guess herself at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以此时她并没有开始对自己产生怀疑。

sentences.en: She's not second guessing her preparations.
sentences.zh: 她没有对自己做出的准备工作产生怀疑。

sentences.en: But in her personal life, I think like everyone else, she's trying to navigate all of this and figure out what the right balance is.
sentences.zh: 但在她的个人生活中，我想就像其他人一样，她试图应对这一切，并找出正确的平衡点。

sentences.en: We were pretty, you know, cautious of where we went and who we did business with from the very beginning and paid more attention.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，我们就对去过的地方和与谁做生意非常，你知道的，谨慎，并且给予了更多关注。

sentences.en: My husband and I do a lot of motorcycling and, you know, we changed a lot of the ways we did things.
sentences.zh: 我和丈夫经常骑摩托车，你知道的，我们改变了很多做事的方式。

sentences.en: Did you have motorcyclist friends who went to Sturgis?
sentences.zh: 你有去斯特吉斯的摩托车手朋友吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我有。

sentences.en: For example, there's this very well-known motorcycle rally called Sturgis in South Dakota.
sentences.zh: 例如，南达科他州有一个非常著名的摩托车集会叫斯特吉斯。

sentences.en: It happens every year in August and it attracts hundreds of thousands of people from around the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 它每年八月举行，吸引了来自中西部各地的数十万人。

sentences.en: And she and her husband were talking about going.
sentences.zh: 她和她丈夫当时在商量要去。

sentences.en: Did you go?
sentences.zh: 你们去了吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我去了。

sentences.en: And actually, we were we were we were supposed to go.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们，我们，我们本来应该去的。

sentences.en: And no, he did not go.
sentences.zh: 然后，不，他没有去。

sentences.en: And, you know, thought long and hard about it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，对此深思熟虑。

sentences.en: But I just was like, you know, my husband and I both because we really were excited about going this year and just decided, no, we just couldn't.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得，你知道的，我和我丈夫都因为我们今年真的很想去，最终还是决定，不，我们实在去不了。

sentences.en: But just because because because we've been there before, we know how in close contact everybody is.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅是因为，因为，因为我们以前去过，我们知道大家的接触是多么紧密。

sentences.en: Ultimately, she and her husband decided not to go to Sturgis,
sentences.zh: 最终，她和丈夫决定不去斯特吉斯，

sentences.en: which in retrospect turned out to be a very good decision because Sturgis was a super spreader event that was responsible for seeding virus throughout the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，这真是一个非常明智的决定，因为斯特吉斯是一个超级传播事件，导致病毒在中西部各地播散。

sentences.en: Tonight, hospitals in the Midwest and the Great Plains are overwhelmed with coronavirus patients.
sentences.zh: 今晚，中西部和大平原地区的医院挤满了冠状病毒患者。

sentences.en: And roughly one third of all new cases are coming from the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 大约三分之一的新增病例都来自中西部。

sentences.en: So coming into the fall, they were seeing six cases a day, nine cases a day.
sentences.zh: 因此，进入秋季，他们每天看到六个病例、九个病例。

sentences.en: And then in October, they're facing a pandemic that is now out of control in the state of Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 然后在十月，他们面临着一场目前在威斯康星州失控的疫情。

sentences.en: So bad.
sentences.zh: 情况太糟了。

sentences.en: Wisconsin just set two records no one wants, the most daily COVID cases and deaths the state's ever seen.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州刚刚创下了两个谁都不想要的纪录，即该州有史以来单日新增新冠病例和死亡人数的最高纪录。

sentences.en: The numbers are really starting to increase at a pretty alarming pace.
sentences.zh: 数字确实开始以相当惊人的速度增长。

sentences.en: More than 17,000 new cases of the virus over the past seven days.
sentences.zh: 在过去七天里，该病毒新增病例超过17,000例。

sentences.en: One hospital system saw a 500 percent rise in COVID patients in the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 某医院系统在过去几周内的新冠患者激增了500%。

sentences.en: More cases here in the state of Wisconsin every day than you saw in New York at the height of the pandemic in the spring.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州每天新增的病例数，比纽约在春季疫情高峰期看到的还要多。

sentences.en: And this is when things start to look really scary in St. Croix County.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，圣克鲁斯县的情况开始显得非常可怕。

sentences.en: St. Croix County officials told WCCO it is one of many counties that have seen a sharp rise in COVID cases in the order.
sentences.zh: 圣克鲁斯县官员告诉 WCCO，它是该命令下新冠病例急剧增加的众多县之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, we started seeing in October, we really started seeing the numbers increasing with our schools and then our nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们从十月份开始，确实看到学校和养老院的数字在增加。

sentences.en: And, you know, suddenly you were knowing more and more people who were testing positive.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，突然之间你认识的检测呈阳性的人越来越多了。

sentences.en: Our public health system itself was really being taxed.
sentences.zh: 我们的公共卫生系统本身正承受着真正的压力。

sentences.en: It was like a snowball.
sentences.zh: 这就像滚雪球一样。

sentences.en: It just all of a sudden the reality of what everyone said was going to happen was actually happening.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，每个人都说会发生的事情，现实中真的发生了。

sentences.en: But what Patty is seeing at the time is that people are behaving like nothing is happening.
sentences.zh: 但帕蒂当时看到的是，人们的表现就像什么事都没发生一样。

sentences.en: They're still holding large weddings indoors.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然在室内举行大型婚礼。

sentences.en: They're still going on weekend trips and getting on airplanes and they're still going to the bars and going to restaurants.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然去周末旅行，坐飞机，仍然去酒吧和餐馆。

sentences.en: And she's kind of looking around with dismay, wondering when people are going to start taking all this seriously.
sentences.zh: 她带着沮丧的心情四处张望，纳闷人们什么时候才能开始认真对待这一切。

sentences.en: Do you ever see someone on the street who's not being safe, someone in the grocery store who's not wearing a mask and you just feel yourself getting angry?
sentences.zh: 你有没有在街上看到过不注意安全的人，在杂货店看到过不戴口罩的人，然后觉得自己开始生气了？

sentences.en: Has anything like that happened?
sentences.zh: 发生过类似的事情吗？

sentences.en: And so I did and someone was being a little snarky because I had a mask on and I just said, you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 所以我这么做了，有人有点尖酸刻薄，因为我戴着口罩，我只是说，不用谢。

sentences.en: Where was that?
sentences.zh: 那是哪里？

sentences.en: It was in the in the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 那是在超市里。

sentences.en: What what did this person say to you?
sentences.zh: 这个人对你说了什么？

sentences.en: Take that effing thing off.
sentences.zh: 把那该死的东西摘下来。

sentences.en: And wow.
sentences.zh: 然后，哇。

sentences.en: And I said, you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 我说，不用谢。

sentences.en: And he says, what do you mean you're welcome?
sentences.zh: 他说，什么叫不用谢？

sentences.en: And I said, well, obviously, I care more about you than you care about me.
sentences.zh: 我说，很明显，我比你在乎我更在乎你。

sentences.en: And I walked away.
sentences.zh: 然后我走开了。

sentences.en: And he just kind of sat there with his mouth open and I just left it at that.
sentences.zh: 他只是张着嘴坐在那里，我就没再理他。

sentences.en: And at the same time, throughout the fall, you have an election approaching.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，整个秋天，选举即将来临。

sentences.en: And on top of everything else, Patty is up for reelection as state senator.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，帕蒂正在竞选连任州参议员。

sentences.en: So what's happening with your campaign at this point and how, you know, how worried were you about trying to keep your seat in November?
sentences.zh: 那么，此时你的竞选情况如何，你对在11月保住席位有多担心？

sentences.en: You know, I was very worried about, you know, was I going to be able to keep it?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我非常担心自己能不能保住这个席位。

sentences.en: And I knew they were coming after me.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们是冲着我来的。

sentences.en: I had a big target on my back.
sentences.zh: 我的后背上被贴了一个大靶子。

sentences.en: I knew that they were outspending me.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们的竞选资金比我多。

sentences.en: And I came up.
sentences.zh: 然后我上去了。

sentences.en: What made you worried, though, when you said you were you were worried about losing the seat?
sentences.zh: 但是，当你刚说担心失去席位时，是什么让你感到担心的？

sentences.en: What in particular was it that made you worried?
sentences.zh: 具体是什么让你担心的？

sentences.en: It was it was the way people were talking about COVID, that it was just not true, that it wasn't as bad as we thought.
sentences.zh: 那是人们谈论新冠肺炎的方式，全都是假话，说它没有我们想象的那么严重。

sentences.en: It just felt like this is going to be a big effing mess.
sentences.zh: 感觉这会是一团糟。

sentences.en: Well, and she's not all that optimistic that she's going to win.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且她对能否获胜并不是那么乐观。

sentences.en: I couldn't knock doors.
sentences.zh: 我不能敲门拜访。

sentences.en: I couldn't have events.
sentences.zh: 我不能办活动。

sentences.en: I couldn't do anything that you normally do.
sentences.zh: 我无法做你平时会做的事。

sentences.en: You know, I could have, but it would have been against everything, I believe, as someone who is engaged in public health.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我本可以，但那将违背我作为一个从事公共卫生工作的人的所有信仰。

sentences.en: She is not really doing a lot of traditional campaign events.
sentences.zh: 她并没有开展很多传统的竞选活动。

sentences.en: But her Republican opponent is doing a lot of those events.
sentences.zh: 但她的共和党竞争对手却在做很多这样的活动。

sentences.en: And at the same time, he's lumping Patty in with a lot of other members of her party who are unpopular, like Governor Evers,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他把帕蒂和她党内许多不受欢迎的成员混为一谈，比如埃弗斯州长，

sentences.en: who is not a popular figure in places like St. Croix County.
sentences.zh: 他在圣克鲁斯县等地并不是一个受欢迎的人物。

sentences.en: Were you seen as a kind of government overreach?
sentences.zh: 你被视为政府权力过度延伸的一种体现吗？

sentences.en: Do you think you were associated with with that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己和那个有关联吗？

sentences.en: Oh, for sure, especially when it came to masks and anything that the governor wanted to do, you know,
sentences.zh: 哦，当然，特别是当涉及到口罩以及州长想要做的任何事情时，你知道的，

sentences.en: and the governor was was doing everything that he could do to keep people safe.
sentences.zh: 州长一直在尽其所能确保人们的安全。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you look at it, you have one one side that saying this thing is coming.
sentences.zh: 而且，你看，你会发现有一方在说这东西要来了。

sentences.en: It's going to be bad.
sentences.zh: 情况会很糟糕。

sentences.en: It's going to be horrible.
sentences.zh: 会非常可怕。

sentences.en: And you've got this other side saying, no, it's not that bad.
sentences.zh: 而另一方则说，不，没那么糟。

sentences.en: It's not that big of a deal.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: You're not going to be impacted.
sentences.zh: 你不会受到影响的。

sentences.en: You're like, OK, I'm going to take the side that saying it isn't going to be bad because that's the easy thing to do.
sentences.zh: 你会想，好吧，我要站在说情况不会变糟的那一边，因为那是容易做到的事。

sentences.en: The hard thing to do is is to say, I'm going to trust the people that think it's going to be bad.
sentences.zh: 难做的是去说，我要信任那些认为情况会变糟的人。

sentences.en: But then what am I going to have to do?
sentences.zh: 但接下来我得做什么呢？

sentences.en: And on election night, did you did you watch from home or what did you do?
sentences.zh: 在选举之夜，你是独自在家观看，还是做了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I watched from home.
sentences.zh: 对，我在家里看的。

sentences.en: I was all by me and my husband and just watch, you know, and I called my campaign manager at about, I don't know, maybe it was a tennis or so.
sentences.zh: 就我和我丈夫两个人，看着，你知道的，我大概在10点左右给我的竞选经理打了个电话。

sentences.en: I said, how does it look?
sentences.zh: 我说，情况怎么样？

sentences.en: And she told me it doesn't look good.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，情况不妙。

sentences.en: And I said, should I call him?
sentences.zh: 我说，我应该给他打电话吗？

sentences.en: And she said, well, let me confirm.
sentences.zh: 她说，好吧，让我确认一下。

sentences.en: And she called me back.
sentences.zh: 然后她回了电话给我。

sentences.en: She goes, yep, go ahead, call him.
sentences.zh: 她说，是的，去吧，给他打电话。

sentences.en: And I called him and that was it to concede.
sentences.zh: 我给他打了电话，就这样认输了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But she didn't seem very upset about losing her seat.
sentences.zh: 但她似乎对失去席位并不是很沮丧。

sentences.en: And you have to keep in mind that at this moment, the virus is completely out of control in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，此时此刻，威斯康星州的病毒已经完全失控了。

sentences.en: It's completely out of control in her community.
sentences.zh: 在她的社区里，它完全失控了。

sentences.en: And she's really focused on that.
sentences.zh: 她真正关注的是这个。

sentences.en: And it wasn't long after the election that I got a message from Patty telling me that the coronavirus had hit very, very close to home.
sentences.zh: 就在选举后不久，我收到了帕蒂的信息，告诉我冠状病毒离她的生活非常非常近。

sentences.en: Hey, Patty.
sentences.zh: 嘿，帕蒂。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I mean, it's a lot, you know, it's the odds are we knew it was going to impact our family, but it's been impacting like gangbusters.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这压力太大了，你知道的，按概率我们知道这会影响到我们的家庭，但它来势汹汹。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅时报才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验时报一个月而不需要输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载纽约时报应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间去突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没订阅纽约时报，今天就下载时报应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: My sister-in-law found out that she was positive.
sentences.zh: 我嫂子发现自己阳性了。

sentences.en: So by mid-November.
sentences.zh: 所以到了11月中旬。

sentences.en: Then after that, my brother-in-law got it and he brought it home to my sister who's a nurse.
sentences.zh: 然后在那之后，我姐夫感染了，他把病毒带回了身为护士的我姐姐家。

sentences.en: Multiple members of Patty's family have tested positive for COVID.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂家族的多个成员新冠检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And my dad tested positive last week.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸上周检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And now my niece, she's a nurse's aide.
sentences.zh: 现在我的侄女，她是一名护士助理。

sentences.en: She just tested positive.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And she works at the same facility where my dad is at.
sentences.zh: 她在和我爸爸相同的机构工作。

sentences.en: So she has to spend some time with him last night.
sentences.zh: 所以她昨晚不得不花了一些时间陪他。

sentences.en: And then now she's going into quarantine.
sentences.zh: 然后现在她要被隔离了。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: One thing after another.
sentences.zh: 一个接一个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the scariest case was her dad, who's 88.
sentences.zh: 最让人害怕的病例是她88岁的父亲。

sentences.en: He has Alzheimer's, which is severe enough that he lives in a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 他患有阿尔茨海默病，病情严重到需要住在疗养院。

sentences.en: And the virus hits him really hard.
sentences.zh: 病毒对他的打击非常沉重。

sentences.en: Within days of getting his positive test, he's very, very sick.
sentences.zh: 在他检测呈阳性后的几天内，他病得非常非常重。

sentences.en: And, you know, two days ago, he started refusing food and medication.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，两天前，他开始拒绝进食和服药。

sentences.en: And now he absolutely won't eat or take food.
sentences.zh: 现在他绝对不肯吃东西或服药了。

sentences.en: But he's still up and about.
sentences.zh: 但他依然能起床走动。

sentences.en: So today we were able to get my mom in there.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们得以让我妈妈进去。

sentences.en: And she was completely gowned up with a suit and everything that she needed to have.
sentences.zh: 她全副武装穿着防护服和她需要的一切装备。

sentences.en: And then they brought him into the room and her together.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把他和她一起带进房间。

sentences.en: And me and my brothers watched and our kids watched from outside.
sentences.zh: 我和我的兄弟们以及我们的孩子们在外面看着。

sentences.en: And we got to observe their love for each other, the way they touched each other.
sentences.zh: 我们得以目睹他们彼此相爱的方式，他们触碰彼此的举动。

sentences.en: You know, they've been married 63 years in January.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，到一月份他们就结婚63年了。

sentences.en: Even though he has Alzheimer's, he had never forgot who my mom is.
sentences.zh: 尽管他患有阿尔茨海默病，但他从未忘记我妈妈是谁。

sentences.en: And as kids, he still knows who we are.
sentences.zh: 作为孩子，他还知道我们是谁。

sentences.en: And he loved life so much that it's like you can just tell he knows he's dying.
sentences.zh: 他那么热爱生活，以至于你能看出他知道自己快要死了。

sentences.en: And he doesn't want to.
sentences.zh: 而且他不想死。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: What a rough time.
sentences.zh: 真是艰难的时期。

sentences.en: Did your mom tell you what they said?
sentences.zh: 你妈妈告诉你他们说的话了吗？

sentences.en: No, and we didn't ask.
sentences.zh: 没有，我们也没问。

sentences.en: So that call was last Thursday.
sentences.zh: 所以那次通话是在上周四。

sentences.en: And a couple of days later, I got a text from Patty.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我收到了帕蒂发来的短信。

sentences.en: Hello, Patty?
sentences.zh: 喂，帕蒂？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi, it's Julie.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是朱莉。

sentences.en: Hey, I got your text.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我收到你的短信了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 我太难过了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I tell you, when we first started chatting, I knew we thought this was going to be part of our conversation.
sentences.zh: 跟你说吧，当我们刚开始聊天时，我知道我们都没想到这会成为我们对话的一部分。

sentences.en: Neither did I.
sentences.zh: 我也没想到。

sentences.en: And I'm so sorry that it is.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾它发生了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I hear you.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So it happened this morning?
sentences.zh: 所以是今天早上发生的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We got a call this morning about 6, you know, that it was going to be soon.
sentences.zh: 我们今天早上6点左右接到电话，你知道的，说快要不行了。

sentences.en: And so we got my mom and so that she could go in and be with him.
sentences.zh: 所以我们找到了我妈妈，好让她能进去陪他。

sentences.en: And then me and my brothers and sister, we all gathered outside.
sentences.zh: 然后我和我的兄弟姐妹们都聚在外面。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: You got to go back.
sentences.zh: 你得回去了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so we were there when he died.
sentences.zh: 所以他去世时我们在场。

sentences.en: And we were talking to our sister from Iowa, Pauline.
sentences.zh: 我们正在和来自爱荷华州的姐姐宝琳说话。

sentences.en: And so when we called Pauline, we told her that, you know, he was taking his last breath and she was listening to music on her phone and it, he couldn't get it to shut off at all.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们给宝琳打电话时，我们告诉她，你知道的，他正在做最后的呼吸，而她正在手机上听音乐，结果，她怎么也关不掉。

sentences.en: So while we were, while we were watching him die in the background, was Rod Schwartz singing forever young.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们在看着他离世时，背景里传来了罗德·施瓦茨唱的《永远年轻》。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it was appropriate for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他很合适。

sentences.en: And yeah, because he was such a strong man, you know, no matter what, you know, that this is going to happen, but it doesn't make it easier.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为他是个如此坚强的男人，你知道的，不管怎样，你知道这终究会发生，但这并不会让事情变得容易一些。

sentences.en: It just is really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的很艰难。

sentences.en: When people talk about, you know, they're just old and, and that there, it's so irritating because no, this was, he was not supposed to die from COVID.
sentences.zh: 当人们谈论时，你知道的，他们只是说他老了，诸如此类，这真的很让人恼火，因为不，这根本不是……他不应该死于新冠。

sentences.en: He was supposed to die from something else.
sentences.zh: 他本该死于其他原因的。

sentences.en: So, you know, now you sit back and you reflect on it and you, I, my sister-in-law and I were
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，现在你坐下来反思这件事，我，我嫂子和我

sentences.en: talking about it this morning and it's just like, you see someone not wearing a mask and you cannot help but be angry.
sentences.zh: 今天早上还在讨论这件事，就感觉，当你看到有人不戴口罩时，你真的忍不住会感到生气。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm just the number of people that you personally know who have COVID people in your family who've had COVID.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只是说你身边亲历新冠的人数，你家里感染过新冠的人数。

sentences.en: I mean, that just seems so extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这看起来太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I mean, how, when you kind of think about that and go one by one, like, how do you process having so many family members so sick with that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，怎么说呢，当你去回想这些并一个接一个地数时，家里有那么多成员病得那么重，你该怎么去接受这一切？

sentences.en: I mean, my family, pretty much all of us work in service.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我的家人，几乎我们所有人都在服务行业工作。

sentences.en: That's, that's what we do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们做的工作。

sentences.en: And I look at this and I wonder how we will be as a family on the other side and not be bitter
sentences.zh: 看着这一切，我在想，等这一切过去后，我们作为一家人会变成什么样，我们还能不能不心存怨恨

sentences.en: in what our next steps will be.
sentences.zh: 以及我们接下来该迈出什么步伐。

sentences.en: I know we'll always be together as a family and I'm not even worried about that.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们一家人永远都会在一起，我甚至不担心这个。

sentences.en: What I'm worried about is how many people that we have to be able to process and, and be able to look at them with empathy and compassion.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是，我们需要去消化多少人的痛苦，并且，还要能够用同理心和慈悲心去面对他们。

sentences.en: And if the experiences we have knock on their doors.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的经历也敲响了他们的房门。

sentences.en: A few weeks, what do you think is going to happen in Wisconsin?
sentences.zh: 几周后，你觉得威斯康星州会发生什么？

sentences.en: How do you see this continuing to play out?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种情况会如何继续发展下去？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's going to get really, really bad because people are, I mean, just being defiant
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为情况会变得非常非常糟糕，因为人们现在，我的意思是，他们只是在公然对抗

sentences.en: right now, but pretty soon is going to be the gun season where people are going to be going up to their cabins and large groups.
sentences.zh: 但很快就要到猎枪季了，人们会成群结队地去他们的度假小屋。

sentences.en: And then right after that is Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 紧接着就是感恩节。

sentences.en: So that pretty much tells you that December is going to be really, it's really going to be interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以这就基本上告诉你，十二月份将会非常，真的会非常有意思。

sentences.en: I mean, we did open up, I sent a memo to the county today that we are transitioning into, uh, the cooler is now open.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们确实开放了，我今天给县里发了一份备忘录，说我们正在过渡，呃，冷藏车现在已经开放了。

sentences.en: This is the cooler that you bought back in March?
sentences.zh: 这就是你三月份买的那辆冷藏车吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We've only had to open it once, but now we will be processing and it will be open for funeral homes that need it for overflow.
sentences.zh: 我们只用过一次，但现在我们要开始处理遗体了，它将对需要临时存放遗体的殡仪馆开放。

sentences.en: When I was talking to a funeral director this weekend, they were like, okay, we have seven bodies in our prep room, which is a lot.
sentences.zh: 这周末我和一位殡仪馆馆长交谈时，他们说，好吧，我们的准备室里现在有七具遗体，这已经很多了。

sentences.en: And they had to turn on the air conditioning because of the odor.
sentences.zh: 因为气味太重，他们不得不打开空调。

sentences.en: And now that we're moving into furnace season and all that, we have to really think about overflow, you know, and your funeral homes tell you there.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要进入供暖季了诸如此类的，我们真的必须考虑遗体超量的问题，你知道的，当你当地的殡仪馆告诉你是

sentences.en: At capacity, you have to pay attention.
sentences.zh: 超负荷运转时，你必须重视起来。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: And I hope your family takes care and, um, uh, keep in touch.
sentences.zh: 希望你和家人多保重，嗯，呃，保持联系。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll talk to you soon.
sentences.zh: 我们过会儿再聊。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Julie, thank you for sharing this story with us.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，谢谢你跟我们分享这个故事。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: This week, officials in St. Croix County voted against new restrictions to limit the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 本周，圣克鲁伊夫县的官员投票否决了旨在限制病毒传播的新限制措施。

sentences.en: Ready.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: The funeral for Patty's father was held on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂父亲的葬礼于周四举行。

sentences.en: An Air Force veteran.
sentences.zh: 他是一名空军退伍军人。

sentences.en: He was honored with a 21-gun salute.
sentences.zh: 他获得了鸣枪二十一响的荣誉礼遇。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The tragedy that could happen is that one of your family members, you know, from coming together in this family gathering, actually could end up being hospitalized and severely
sentences.zh: 可能发生的悲剧是，由于这次家庭聚会的相聚，你们家庭中的某位成员，你知道的，最终可能会住院并病情严重

sentences.en: ill and die.
sentences.zh: 甚至死亡。

sentences.en: And we certainly don't want to see that happen.
sentences.zh: 我们当然不希望看到这种情况发生。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Thursday, officials from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sentences.zh: 在周四举行的新闻发布会上，疾病控制与预防中心的官员

sentences.en: urged Americans not to travel for the Thanksgiving holiday and to consider canceling plans to gather with relatives outside their households.
sentences.zh: 敦促美国人在感恩节假期不要出行，并考虑取消与同住家庭之外的亲属聚会的计划。

sentences.en: All Americans want to do the right thing to protect their families, even when there are hard decisions to be made.
sentences.zh: 所有美国人都希望做正确的事来保护他们的家人，即使面临艰难的决定。

sentences.en: We all must do our best to protect those around us.
sentences.zh: 我们都必须尽最大努力保护我们周围的人。

sentences.en: And the Georgia Secretary of State reaffirmed on Thursday night that President-elect Joe Biden
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州国务卿周四晚间重申，经过特朗普要求的、耗时六天的重新手工计票后，候任总统乔·拜登

sentences.en: defeated President Trump in the state after a hand recount requested by Trump that took six days.
sentences.zh: 在该州击败了特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Trump is now seeking to block or delay the certification of the results in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 特朗普目前正试图阻止或推迟密歇根州选举结果的认证。

sentences.en: The president has invited the state's top two Republican legislators to the White House today to seek their help in that effort.
sentences.zh: 总统今天邀请了该州两名最高共和党议员前往白宫，以寻求他们在这一努力中的帮助。

sentences.en: But the effort is unlikely to succeed.
sentences.zh: 但这一努力不太可能成功。

sentences.en: Biden won Michigan by 157,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 拜登在密歇根州以157,000票的优势获胜。

sentences.en: And the two legislators meeting with Trump have previously said that they would abide by the outcome of the vote.
sentences.zh: 与特朗普会面的两名议员此前曾表示，他们将遵守投票结果。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人心潮澎湃的权力争斗中。
